name: Sodom
overview: Scripture presents Sodom as a city situated on the well-watered plain of the Jordan River, marking the southeastern boundary of the Canaanites (Genesis 10:19; 13:10). Lot, Abraham's nephew, chose to dwell near Sodom despite the men of the city being described as exceedingly wicked and sinners before the Lord (Genesis 13:12-13). Sodom's king, Bera, allied with other kings to resist the invasion led by Chedorlaomer, highlighting the city's political involvement (Genesis 14:1-2). Ultimately, the biblical narrative emphasizes the city's destruction as a direct consequence of its inhabitants' great wickedness.
